CI is red on PR #484 only because the two new live-harness tests launch Playwright Chromium, and the npm test jobs do not install a browser. The local full suite passes. Fix the tests and the browser-smoke wiring.
1. tests/command-center-live-latency.test.mjs and tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs: when the Playwright launch fails because the browser executable is missing (message contains 'Executable doesn't exist', 'Looks like Playwright was just installed', or the error is a browserType.launch error), call t.skip('playwright chromium not installed') and return instead of failing. Do not swallow other errors. Keep the existing assertions when Chromium is available. A small shared local helper in each file is fine.
2. package.json: extend the `test:browser` script so the browser-smoke CI job (which runs `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` and then `npm run test:browser`) also runs these two files: 'node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/browser/*.smoke.mjs tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs tests/command-center-live-latency.test.mjs'. Keep every other script unchanged.
3. Verify on this Mac: `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs tests/command-center-live-latency.test.mjs` passes with the installed browser; and with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/empty-browsers` the same command reports skipped (create the empty dir). Do not change the harness behavior or thresholds.

Verify: the two commands above, plus `npm run test:browser` (if the local browser is installed; it should pass or skip only the known toolchain cases). Report both outcomes.
